# DAGMiningResult { #dyf.DAGMiningResult }

```python
DAGMiningResult(chains, diversity, parent_child_edges, n_components)
```

Result of DAG mining on an embedding space.

DAG mining finds hierarchical structures by using neighbor diversity
as a generality signal. Points with diverse neighbors (connecting
many topics) are considered "general", while points with coherent
neighbors (tight clusters) are "specific".

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name               | Type                                                                                                 | Description                                     |
|--------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| chains             | [list](`list`)\[[DAGChain](`dyf.ontology.DAGChain`)\]                                                | List of extracted DAG chains                    |
| diversity          | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`)                                                             | Neighbor diversity score for each point         |
| parent_child_edges | [list](`list`)\[[tuple](`tuple`)\[[int](`int`), [int](`int`), [float](`float`), [float](`float`)\]\] | List of (parent, child, similarity, gap) tuples |
| n_components       | [int](`int`)                                                                                         | Number of connected components in the DAG       |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [get_chains_by_coherence](#dyf.DAGMiningResult.get_chains_by_coherence) | Return chains with at least min_coherence. |
| [get_chains_by_length](#dyf.DAGMiningResult.get_chains_by_length) | Return chains with at least min_length nodes. |
| [summary](#dyf.DAGMiningResult.summary) | Return summary statistics. |

### get_chains_by_coherence { #dyf.DAGMiningResult.get_chains_by_coherence }

```python
DAGMiningResult.get_chains_by_coherence(min_coherence=0.65)
```

Return chains with at least min_coherence.
